options.name: first
options.description: Only relevant if I(state=present). If you want to assign the device the first order, set the value of C(first) to C(1).

options.name: force_reboot
options.description: Can VM be forced to power off and on. Only used when modifications to the VM require it to be powered off and VM does not respond to a shutdown request within I(shutdown_timeout) limit. Before this is utilized, a shutdown request is sent.

options.name: items
options.description: The boot devices items we want to change.

options.name: shutdown_timeout
options.description: How long does ansible controller wait for VMs response to a shutdown request. In seconds.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the boot devices specified by C(items). If I(state=present) devices specified by C(items) will be added to list of boot devices. If I(state=absent) devices specified by C(items) will be removed from the list of boot devices. If I(state=set) VM boot devices will be set exactly to devices specified by C(items).

options.name: vm_name
options.description: Virtual machine name. Used to identify selected virtual machine by name.
